name: Apogee 21 Holdings, Inc.
summary: Apogee 21 Holdings, Inc. doing business as A21 Wine & Spirits, produces and markets craft spirits and wine. The company owns Monkey in Paradise Vodka, Andale Tequila, and Blue Nectar Tequila brands. The company also has the sales agency for Zunte Mezcal, and Finca Ferrer Wines from Argentina. The company was formerly known as 30DC, Inc. and changed its name to Apogee 21 Holdings, Inc. in August 2022. Apogee 21 Holdings, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
